repositories.name: graphBackon
repositories.description: make your project UI without AI large model needed
repositories.overview: PyArch Graph is a local-first Python architecture explorer. A FastAPI backend reads a directory on the machine where it runs, parses Python with the standard-library AST without importing or executing project code, and exposes a typed graph. The frontend is a plain HTML, CSS, and JavaScript application served by FastAPI as a readable 2D file map.

repositories.name: Local_chatbot
repositories.description: local RAG based chatbot with administrator dashboard
repositories.overview: A local, Persian-language retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) chatbot with a user chat interface and an administrator dashboard. It stores question-and-answer records, PDF knowledge-base chunks, chat history, feedback, and application logs in MySQL.

repositories.name: jarvisjoon-local-agent
repositories.description: totally local agent for every PCs with any confgs
repositories.overview: JarvisJoon is a local coding assistant using models/gemma-4-E2B-it/. It inspects project files, searches code, checks Git status, and optionally applies changes after you approve each preview. The model proposes actions; application code validates and authorizes them. It starts read-only, uses no cloud API, and cannot execute arbitrary commands.
